name: @mila/registry
description: Mila Curated Component and Template Registry — installable UI/UX toolkit dependency

scripts.build: bun run build:bundle && bun run build:types
scripts.build:bundle: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --splitting && cp src/registry.json dist/registry.json && cp -r src/components dist/components && cp -r src/lib dist/lib 2>/dev/null || true
